results.overview: Bernard, the youngest child of a Batak family, faces an inner conflict when his desire to become a priest clashes with his family's expectation of a civil servant. Haunted by the call of faith and caught between love, family, and his faith, Bernard must make life choices that will determine his future.

results.title: Voices in my Head

She is convinced that her parents were murdered by a creepy woman who haunts their home. Increasingly, Kevin must realize that his sister is in great danger.

results.original_title: John and Carolyn: Love, Beauty and Loss
results.overview: Love, ambition and legacy collide under an unrelenting public spotlight throughout John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's relationship and tragic deaths in the 1990s.

results.title: Ангельский чин
results.overview: Open the door to a world nearly 500 years old! This documentary takes viewers to the Novodevichy Convent—one of Russia's most famous and enigmatic monasteries, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Behind its majestic walls lies not only the country's great history but also the living, poignant stories of women who dedicated themselves to its service.

results.original_title: Jules Massenet : Werther Opéra Comique, Paris
results.overview: Goethe's masterpiece set to music by Jules Massenet can be rediscovered on stage at the Opéra Comique, conducted by Raphaël Pichon and directed by Ted Huffman.

results.title: Sukkwan Island
results.overview: In an effort to reconnect with his estranged father, 13-year-old Roy agrees to spend a formative year of adventure on the remote Sukkwan Island deep in the Norwegian fjords. What starts as a chance to rebuild their relationship quickly descends into a test of survival as they face the harsh realities of their environment and confront their unresolved turmoil.

results.title: A Nadadora
results.overview: Costa da Morte, 1990s. Nico is a young girl who spends her days poaching alongside her father, Tano, a former heroin addict who shares his profits with her. But sometimes, a strange noise creeps into Nico’s mind. The world goes dark, and she loses consciousness, only to wake up somewhere else, with no memory of how she got there. As these absences become part of her life, Nico begins to venture into the unknown depths of her own mind, discovering something unexpected in the darkness: a strength that makes her feel less alone.
